keyconfounds: Full source Makefile case640×480, seed123 input and245760 boxes, exact original RNG draw order, color(255,204,203,1), all245760 launches and original box order retained. No GPU union/fusion/subsampling shortcut.

Source always reads original input rather than previous output, with one common color. Overlaps therefore write the same single-blend result, not repeated alpha accumulation. CPU-only rectangle union is an independent oracle shortcut, not less GPU work.

Color alpha is1/255, not normalized1/opaque fill. RGB output uses rounded Float32 alpha/one-minus-alpha; Float64 oracle and full source absolute1e-3 acceptance preserve this faint-opacity source contract.

The source is detection-window visualization over RGB images, not detector inference/training/precision-recall or a scientific application dataset. Source synthetic random pixels/rectangles are retained; no real-image quality conclusion.

Input/output remain distinct AoS12-byte Float32 RGB pixels; Box has fourInt32 fields/16bytes. Julia NTuple3Float32 and immutable Box match logical element sizes, but vector-load/store/FMA code generation may differ.

ROI is the complete245760-iteration CPU launch/configuration loop plus device completion, matching the source. It is not isolated GPU timestamp duration. Per-call framework dispatch/grid configuration overhead is included; no pure device-throughput/host-bottleneck causal claim without profiling.

All8×8 blocks and per-box ceil grids are preserved, including padded inactive lanes and image-bound clipping. JACC cached LaunchSpec.blocks is explicitly recomputed for every rectangle; dynamic shared memory is explicitly0. No unsupported varying-shape claim.

All307200 pixels/921600 RGB channels checked in every trial, including307198 covered and2 unchanged pixels; actual1904647-value Double prefix is byteexact. Box ints are represented exactly in metadata only; actual host/device geometry is Int32, no floating integer emulation.

Source-level exact work counts:3657418592 valid pixel updates,4218004544 launched lanes,87778046208 logical image read+write bytes. These are not measured cache/DRAM traffic or physical instruction/FLOP counts. Inputs/output repeated working set and launch granularity constrain roofline interpretation.

FMA/Float32 rounding yields max CPU absolute7.62893e-6, tolerated below1e-3; not a failed numerical attempt or a claim of exact real arithmetic. Saved finite/range/uncovered-pixel checks and direct all5 dual-reference comparisons pass.

One complete box batch warms Julia/JIT before five in-process full-batch trials; mean last four with no outlier removal. Buffer copy/reset, transfers, independent oracle and serialization are outside ROI; blocking device-wide completion used throughout.

Native source untouched; old Julia dummy marker/PASS restored to actual pixel helper and full source host launch loop. Shared semantic helper/fixture/oracle/reference cost is separate from portable wrappers.

All CUDA.jl/KA/JACC device code uses own framework indices and standard pure Julia pixel helper, no foreign CUDA device API or vendor operator library. CUDA host allocation/completion only NVIDIA tested, not cross-vendor portability.

Each current reference/KA/JACC candidate passes its first actual device-JIT check, one generic kernel definition. This uses prior framework knowledge and shared source math; it is not a context-free zero-shot first-program claim. Internal compiler passes/specializations unknown.

Context/cache/reasoning/coordination usage includes overlapping workflow/child windows, not exclusive billed translation costs. JACC uses prior cached-launch-grid experience proactively; that experience is not invented as a new failed overlay candidate.

scientific_intent.scientific_task: Render translucent rectangular detection-window overlays onto an RGB image using a fixed source color and opacity. The source supplies synthetic pixels/windows, not detections from a trained model.
scientific_intent.mathematical_operation: For each rectangle and in-image pixel, output=alpha*colorRGB+(1-alpha)*originalInputRGB, alpha=Float32(1/255). All rectangles share color and read original input, so union coverage determines final single-blend output.
scientific_intent.discretization_or_topology: 640×480 row-major RGB image,245760 axis-aligned integer rectangles,8×8 GPU blocks per rectangle, upper-edge clipping and dense overlap.
invariants: All output channels finite and within RGB range up to source tolerance.
Every covered pixel equals one source blend, regardless of overlap count; every uncovered pixel equals original input.
All source boxes/launch order/grid extents preserved; all1904647 actual input-prefix values byteexact.
Every921600 RGB output value checked against independent coverage/affine oracle in every model/trial.
accuracy_requirements: Original absolute1e-3 source tolerance for full RGB arrays, plus direct CUDA/CUDA.jl comparisons for allfive trials.
Independent Float64 affine oracle with actual rounded Float32 alpha/ialpha and integer rectangle-union coverage; no GPU work reduction.
Exact actual input image/Box/color/shape prefix, finite outputs, range and two unchanged-pixel checks.
scientific_intent.precision_sensitivity: Float32 blending/FMA contraction introduces tolerated real-arithmetic drift; geometry remains actual Int32. Alpha source convention1/255 is preserved rather than changed to opacity1.
scientific_intent.input_size_regimes: Original640×480/0.8pixels box count245760 and source seed123; other resolutions, per-box colors, negative coordinates and alternate alpha conventions unmeasured.
scientific_intent.community_use_case: Computer-vision detection visualization and image compositing primitive, not model accuracy or physics inference.
scientific_intent.uncertainty: Full-batch ROI includes many host dispatch calls; no causal host/GPU bottleneck or measured roofline position without profiles. Dense overlap creates redundant but intentionally retained source work.
